discSwitcherSpacesRules.text:
Rules (approved 2026-11-21)

• Space line under a channel only when your ⌘K spans more than one space: a small └ then the space name, one step smaller than the channel name. Then every channel row has it, Pasodrum too. One space: rows as today.

• DMs and People: a tag right after the name. External → the yellow “External”; a client → their client space’s name in that space’s colour (“Nordlys”); team → nothing. Outside mark on the avatar as everywhere else.

• Names come only from spaces you’re in yourself, so ⌘K can’t name a space you’re not in.

• Clients see no tags (Externals are team to them). A client in one space sees ⌘K exactly as today.

• Recent conversations use the same rows.

client-spaces-Main-contacts-rules.text:
Rules (approved 2026-11-21)

• Owners and Admins mark Staff as a client space’s main contact from People → ⋯ (Make main contact / Remove as main contact). One or more; Owners and Admins count as Staff; never Externals or clients. Your own row has the item too.

• A main contact gets a “Main contact” tag beside their name.

• “Need help?” names the first main contact and reaches every main contact. With none marked it goes to whoever added the client, then the space’s Owners and Admins, as today (D-38).

boards-All-issues.text: All issues and the active space (approved 2026-11-22)

boards-side07-rules.text:
Rules: space-scoped Docs and Boards, All issues (approved 2026-11-22)

• Docs and Boards show only the space whose tile is lit. No space heading.

• In Docs or Boards, a space tile keeps you there and opens that space. Home goes back to channels.

• My issues: mine, every space.

• All issues: only in Pasodrum (team). Every open issue in every space you’re in, grouped by project, space named on each group. Active space first; late first.

• Press a face top right to see that person’s issues; dashed face = nobody. Press again to clear.

• A custom column (Waiting on client) is named on the row. List only, no New issue.

• In a client space, and for clients: My issues only, no All issues.

overview-Rail-tidy.text: Rail: theme in the profile menu, Activity icon-only (DES-05, approved 2026-11-22)

client-spaces-Archived-delete-rules.text:
Rules (approved 2026-11-22)

• Team: an archived client space leaves the rail; while you view one its tile shows dimmed.
• Pasodrum menu (Owner/Admin): New client space + Archived client spaces, after a divider.
• Delete: Owner only, archived spaces only, type the name. Pasodrum can never be deleted.
• Clients: unchanged.

disc-DES-06-rules.text:
Proposed rule (DES-06)

• Every "nothing here yet" page: 64 tile, 22 title, then one standard button (36 high, radius 9, 14/600, padding 16, icon gap 7).
• Tile → title → button: 20 apart.

Boards changes: button 40 → 36, radius 10 → 9, 15 → 14, padding 15/18 → 16/16, gap 8 → 7, 22 → 20 above.
Docs changes: padding 11/14 → 16/16, gap 6 → 7.
